## benchmark

*Benchmark a Generation Function*

```
_B_e_n_c_h_m_a_r_k _a _G_e_n_e_r_a_t_i_o_n _F_u_n_c_t_i_o_n

_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:

     Run a generation function and return timing information along with
     results.

_U_s_a_g_e:

     benchmark(expr, times, verbose)
     
_A_r_g_u_m_e_n_t_s:

    expr: An expression to benchmark (typically a call to tti, itv, or
          stv)

   times: Number of times to repeat (default: 1)

 verbose: Print timing information (default: TRUE)

_V_a_l_u_e:

     A list with: \item{result}{The result from the last run}
     \item{elapsed}{Elapsed time in seconds for each run}
     \item{mean}{Mean elapsed time} \item{total}{Total elapsed time}

_E_x_a_m_p_l_e_s:

     ## Not run:
     
       # Benchmark text-to-image
       result <- benchmark(tti("A sunset", backend = "diffusers_api"))
     
       # Multiple runs for comparison
       result <- benchmark(tti("A cat", backend = "openai"), times = 3)
       result$mean  # average time
     
       # Compare backends
       t1 <- benchmark(tti("A dog", backend = "openai"))
       t2 <- benchmark(tti("A dog", backend = "diffusers_api"))
       cat("OpenAI:", t1$elapsed, "s\n")
       cat("diffusers_api:", t2$elapsed, "s\n")
     ## End(Not run)
     
```

## ip_adapter_face

*IP-Adapter for Face Consistency (Convenience Function)*

```
_I_P-_A_d_a_p_t_e_r _f_o_r _F_a_c_e _C_o_n_s_i_s_t_e_n_c_y (_C_o_n_v_e_n_i_e_n_c_e _F_u_n_c_t_i_o_n)

_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:

     Shortcut for generating face-consistent images using FaceID. Uses
     sensible defaults optimized for face generation.

_U_s_a_g_e:

     ip_adapter_face(prompt, face_image, file, scale, ...)
     
_A_r_g_u_m_e_n_t_s:

  prompt: Character. What the person should be doing/wearing/where.

face_image: Character. Path to a clear face photo.

    file: Character. Output file path.

   scale: Numeric. Face similarity strength (0-1). Default 0.6. Higher
          = more similar but less prompt adherence.

     ...: Additional arguments passed to ip_adapter().

_V_a_l_u_e:

     Invisibly returns the file path.

_E_x_a_m_p_l_e_s:

     ## Not run:
     
     # Generate person as astronaut
     ip_adapter_face(
       prompt = "Professional photo of a person as an astronaut, NASA suit, space background",
       face_image = "my_face.jpg",
       file = "me_astronaut.png"
     )
     
     # Generate person in different style
     ip_adapter_face(
       prompt = "Oil painting portrait, renaissance style, dramatic lighting",
       face_image = "my_face.jpg",
       file = "me_renaissance.png",
       scale = 0.5  # Lower scale for more style influence
     )
     ## End(Not run)
     
```

## ip_adapter

*Generate Image with IP-Adapter*

```
_G_e_n_e_r_a_t_e _I_m_a_g_e _w_i_t_h _I_P-_A_d_a_p_t_e_r

_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:

     Generate an image using IP-Adapter with a reference image for face
     or style consistency. This is ideal when you only have 1-2
     reference images and don't want to train a LoRA.

_U_s_a_g_e:

     ip_adapter(prompt, reference_image, ip_adapter_type, model, ip_adapter_scale, negative_prompt, steps, guidance_scale, width, height, file, timeout)
     
_A_r_g_u_m_e_n_t_s:

  prompt: Character. The text description of the image to generate.

reference_image: Character. Path to reference image file OR base64
          string.

ip_adapter_type: Character. Type of IP-Adapter to use: - "standard":
          Basic style/content transfer - "plus": Better detail
          preservation (ViT-H encoder) - "face": Face generation using
          CLIP (good for faces) - "faceid": Uses InsightFace embeddings
          (best for face accuracy) - "faceid-plus": Combines FaceID +
          CLIP (best quality faces)

   model: Character. Base model to use. Default
          "stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0".

ip_adapter_scale: Numeric. Influence of reference image (0-1). Default
          0.6.

negative_prompt: Character. What to avoid in the image.

   steps: Integer. Number of inference steps. Default 30.

guidance_scale: Numeric. CFG scale. Default 7.5.

   width: Integer. Output image width. Default 1024.

  height: Integer. Output image height. Default 1024.

    file: Character or NULL. If provided, save the image to this path.

 timeout: Numeric. Request timeout in seconds. Default 300.

_V_a_l_u_e:

     A list with the generated image data, or invisibly returns the
     file path if `file` is specified.

_E_x_a_m_p_l_e_s:

     ## Not run:
     
     # Face consistency with single reference photo
     tti_base("http://localhost:8000")
     ip_adapter(
       prompt = "A photo of a man as an astronaut on the moon",
       reference_image = "face_photo.jpg",
       ip_adapter_type = "faceid",
       file = "astronaut.png"
     )
     
     # Style transfer
     ip_adapter(
       prompt = "A cat sitting on a windowsill",
       reference_image = "painting_style.jpg",
       ip_adapter_type = "standard",
       ip_adapter_scale = 0.8,
       file = "styled_cat.png"
     )
     
     # Best face quality with FaceID Plus
     ip_adapter(
       prompt = "Portrait photo, professional lighting, studio background",
       reference_image = "my_face.jpg",
       ip_adapter_type = "faceid-plus",
       ip_adapter_scale = 0.7,
       file = "portrait.png"
     )
     ## End(Not run)
     
```

```
_G_e_n_e_r_a_t_e _V_i_d_e_o _f_r_o_m _I_m_a_g_e (_I_m_a_g_e-_t_o-_V_i_d_e_o)

_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:
```

## stv

*Generate Talking Head Video (Speech-to-Video)*

```
_G_e_n_e_r_a_t_e _T_a_l_k_i_n_g _H_e_a_d _V_i_d_e_o (_S_p_e_e_c_h-_t_o-_V_i_d_e_o)

_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:

          string

 face_id: Cached face ID (use instead of image for faster generation)

_V_a_l_u_e:

       stv("face.png", "audio.mp3", enhance = TRUE)
     
       # Using cached face for faster generation
       face <- stv_face_create("portrait.jpg")
       stv(face_id = face$id, audio = "speech.wav")
     ## End(Not run)
     
```

## tti

*Generate Image from Text*

```
_G_e_n_e_r_a_t_e _I_m_a_g_e _f_r_o_m _T_e_x_t

_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:

     Generate an image from a text prompt using multiple backends.

_U_s_a_g_e:

     tti(prompt, backend, model, negative_prompt, size, quality, style, n, steps, guidance_scale, seed, lora, lora_scale, devices, response_format, file, timeout)
     
_A_r_g_u_m_e_n_t_s:

  prompt: Character. The text description of the image to generate.

 backend: Character. Which backend to use: - "openai": DALL-E API
          (requires API key) - "diffuseR": Local diffuseR package -
          "diffusers_api": HTTP API (Z-Image-Turbo, SD) - "auto": Use
          diffuseR if available, else openai

   model: Character. Model to use. Depends on backend: - OpenAI:
          "dall-e-3", "dall-e-2" - diffuseR: "sd21", "sdxl" -
          diffusers_api: "Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo", any HF model ID

negative_prompt: Character or NULL. Negative prompt (diffuseR,
          diffusers_api only).

    size: Character. Image dimensions (e.g., "1024x1024").

 quality: Character. Image quality: "standard" or "hd" (DALL-E 3 only).

   style: Character. Image style: "vivid" or "natural" (DALL-E 3 only).

       n: Integer. Number of images (OpenAI only).

   steps: Integer. Inference steps (diffuseR, diffusers_api only).
          Default 50.

guidance_scale: Numeric. CFG scale. Default 7.5.

    seed: Integer or NULL. Random seed for reproducibility.

    lora: Character or list. LoRA model(s) for character/style
          consistency (diffusers_api only). Can be a path string for
          single LoRA, or a list of lists with `path` and `scale`
          elements for multiple LoRAs.

lora_scale: Numeric. Weight for single LoRA (0-1). Default 0.8. Ignored
          if `lora` is a list with explicit scales.

 devices: Device configuration for diffuseR: "cpu", "cuda", or list.

response_format: Character. "url" or "b64_json" (OpenAI only).

    file: Character or NULL. If provided, save the image to this path.

 timeout: Timeout in seconds (diffusers_api only). Default 120.

_V_a_l_u_e:

     A list containing the generated image data. Structure varies by
     backend.

_E_x_a_m_p_l_e_s:

     ## Not run:
     
     # Using OpenAI DALL-E
     xtx_set_api_key("sk-...")
     result <- tti("A white cat on a windowsill")
     browseURL(result$data[[1]]$url)
     
     # Using local diffuseR
     result <- tti("A sunset over mountains", backend = "diffuseR")
     
     # Using diffusers_api with Z-Image-Turbo
     tti_base("http://localhost:8000")
     result <- tti("A robot DJ", backend = "diffusers_api",
                   model = "Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo")
     
     # Using LoRA for character consistency
     tti("photo of sks person smiling", backend = "diffusers_api",
         lora = "/models/loras/my_character.safetensors",
         lora_scale = 0.85, file = "character.png")
     
     # Multiple LoRAs
     tti("photo of sks person in anime style", backend = "diffusers_api",
         lora = list(
           list(path = "character.safetensors", scale = 0.8),
           list(path = "anime_style.safetensors", scale = 0.6)
         ))
     
     # Save to file
     tti("A sunset over mountains", file = "sunset.png")
     ## End(Not run)
     
```

## xtx_img_edit

*Edit Image with Text Prompt*

```
_E_d_i_t _I_m_a_g_e _w_i_t_h _T_e_x_t _P_r_o_m_p_t

_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:

     Edit an existing image using a text prompt. Uses DALL-E 2 edits
     endpoint for OpenAI backend, or diffuseR img2img for local models.

_U_s_a_g_e:

     xtx_img_edit(image, prompt, backend, model, mask, negative_prompt, size, strength, steps, guidance_scale, seed, devices, n, response_format, file)
     
_A_r_g_u_m_e_n_t_s:

   image: Character. Path to the input image file.

  prompt: Character. The text description of the desired
          edit/transformation.

 backend: Character. Which backend to use: "openai" or "diffuser".

   model: Character. Model to use. For OpenAI: "dall-e-2". For
          diffuseR: "sd21", "sdxl".

    mask: Character or NULL. Path to mask image (OpenAI only).
          Transparent areas indicate where to edit.

negative_prompt: Character or NULL. Negative prompt (diffuseR only).

    size: Character. Output size. For OpenAI: "256x256", "512x512",
          "1024x1024". For diffuseR: "512x512", "768x768", "1024x1024".

strength: Numeric. Transformation strength 0-1 (diffuseR only). Default
          0.8.

   steps: Integer. Number of inference steps (diffuseR only). Default
          50.

guidance_scale: Numeric. CFG scale (diffuseR only). Default 7.5.

    seed: Integer or NULL. Random seed (diffuseR only).

 devices: Character or list. Device configuration (diffuseR only).

       n: Integer. Number of images to generate (OpenAI only).

response_format: Character. "url" or "b64_json" (OpenAI only).

    file: Character or NULL. If provided, save the first result to this
          path.

_V_a_l_u_e:

     A list containing the generated image data.

_E_x_a_m_p_l_e_s:

     ## Not run:
     
     # OpenAI edit with mask
     result <- xtx_img_edit(
       image = "photo.png",
       prompt = "Add a red hat",
       mask = "mask.png"
     )
     
     # diffuseR img2img
     result <- xtx_img_edit(
       image = "photo.png",
       prompt = "Make it look like a painting",
       backend = "diffuser",
       strength = 0.7
     )
     ## End(Not run)
     
```

## xtx_img_variation

*Create Image Variations*

```
_C_r_e_a_t_e _I_m_a_g_e _V_a_r_i_a_t_i_o_n_s

_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:

     Generate variations of an existing image using DALL-E 2. Note:
     This function only works with the OpenAI backend.

_U_s_a_g_e:

     xtx_img_variation(image, model, size, n, response_format, file)
     
_A_r_g_u_m_e_n_t_s:

   image: Character. Path to the input image file (PNG, max 4MB,
          square).

   model: Character. The model to use. Currently only "dall-e-2"
          supported.

    size: Character. Output size: "256x256", "512x512", or "1024x1024".

       n: Integer. Number of variations to generate (1-10).

response_format: Character. "url" or "b64_json".

    file: Character or NULL. If provided, save the first result to this
          path.

_V_a_l_u_e:

     A list containing the generated image data.

_E_x_a_m_p_l_e_s:

     ## Not run:
     
     xtx_set_api_key("sk-...")
     result <- xtx_img_variation("photo.png", n = 3)
     ## End(Not run)
     
```

## xtx_set_api_base

*Set API Base URL*

```
_S_e_t _A_P_I _B_a_s_e _U_R_L

_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:

     Configure the base URL for the image generation API. Defaults to
     OpenAI's API endpoint.

_U_s_a_g_e:

     xtx_set_api_base(url)
     
_A_r_g_u_m_e_n_t_s:

     url: Character. The base URL (without trailing slash).

_V_a_l_u_e:

     Invisibly returns the previous base URL value.

_E_x_a_m_p_l_e_s:

     ## Not run:
     
     # Use OpenAI
     xtx_set_api_base("https://api.openai.com")
     
     # Use a local server
     xtx_set_api_base("http://localhost:8000")
     ## End(Not run)
     
```

## xtx_supported_models

*Get Supported Image Models*

```
_G_e_t _S_u_p_p_o_r_t_e_d _I_m_a_g_e _M_o_d_e_l_s

_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:

_A_r_g_u_m_e_n_t_s:

```

## xtx_txt2img

*Generate Image from Text (Deprecated)*

```
_G_e_n_e_r_a_t_e _I_m_a_g_e _f_r_o_m _T_e_x_t (_D_e_p_r_e_c_a_t_e_d)

_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:

     *[Deprecated]*

     This function is deprecated. Use ‘tti()’ instead.

_U_s_a_g_e:

     xtx_txt2img(
       prompt,
       backend = c("openai", "diffuser", "diffusers_api", "auto"),
       model = NULL,
       negative_prompt = NULL,
       size = NULL,
       quality = "standard",
       style = "vivid",
       n = 1,
       steps = 50,
       guidance_scale = 7.5,
       seed = NULL,
       devices = "cpu",
       response_format = "url",
       file = NULL,
       timeout = 120
     )
     
_A_r_g_u_m_e_n_t_s:

  prompt: Character. The text description of the image to generate.

 backend: Character. Which backend to use:

            • "openai": DALL-E API (requires API key)

            • "diffuseR": Local diffuseR package

            • "diffusers_api": HTTP API (Z-Image-Turbo, SD)

            • "auto": Use diffuseR if available, else openai

   model: Character. Model to use. Depends on backend:

            • OpenAI: "dall-e-3", "dall-e-2"

            • diffuseR: "sd21", "sdxl"

            • diffusers_api: "Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo", any HF model
              ID

negative_prompt: Character or NULL. Negative prompt (diffuseR,
          diffusers_api only).

    size: Character. Image dimensions (e.g., "1024x1024").

 quality: Character. Image quality: "standard" or "hd" (DALL-E 3 only).

   style: Character. Image style: "vivid" or "natural" (DALL-E 3 only).

       n: Integer. Number of images (OpenAI only).

   steps: Integer. Inference steps (diffuseR, diffusers_api only).
          Default 50.

guidance_scale: Numeric. CFG scale. Default 7.5.

    seed: Integer or NULL. Random seed for reproducibility.

 devices: Device configuration for diffuseR: "cpu", "cuda", or list.

response_format: Character. "url" or "b64_json" (OpenAI only).

    file: Character or NULL. If provided, save the image to this path.

 timeout: Timeout in seconds (diffusers_api only). Default 120.

_V_a_l_u_e:

     See ‘tti()’

_S_e_e _A_l_s_o:

     ‘tti()’

```
